resources.string: Install the Linux environment (Alpine minirootfs, ~3 MB)? Runs once; scheduled when charging or idle.
Install %1$s (%2$s)? Runs once — the built-in X11 desktop installs with it.
Install %1$s (%2$s)? Your other installed distro(s) stay on disk: %3$s. The active distro powers both the Terminal and Desktop tabs.
Bootstrap failed — tap Install now to retry.
Ongoing notification while Linux sessions run
chroot instead of interpreter-path mode + cgroup tuning
Keep CPU awake during active bursts
Auto-expiring wake lock (30 s) — off saves more battery
Fixes “dpkg was interrupted” / status-old backup errors inside the active distro; runs in the background
Repair started in the background — retry your apt command in the terminal

During install, also fetch Xvfb + Openbox + xterm + capture tools via the distro package manager (~25 MB one time on Alpine, ~60 MB on Debian/Ubuntu). Disable on slow connections; the terminal works either way.
Distro to install/run (Alpine, Debian or Ubuntu). They coexist on disk; the selected one is active. Changing this shows an Install prompt — nothing downloads without your tap.
